The '''55th Mechanized Brigade''' was a mechanized [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]<ref name="Order 66" /> of 9,216 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], with added support personnel, that served in one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Corps/Legends|corps]]<ref name="Composition" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Order 66" /> Led by a [[senior clone commander]],<ref name="Leadership" /> [[Unidentified clone trooper lieutenant (Pols Anaxes)|one]] of the 55th's [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenants]] served as camp [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Republic Detention Center]] in [[Pols Anaxes]],<ref name="Order 66" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]],<ref name="Anaxes">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> after getting an injury that made [[Gender/Legends|him]] walk stiffly.<ref name="Order 66" />

Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the 55th Mechanized Brigade's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] greeted the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Bardan Jusik]], posing as a prisoner, and three ex-Republic [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] disguised as ordinary clones; [[Fi Skirata|Fi]], [[Spar]], and [[Sull]], who sought to free the imprisoned [[Ruusaan Skirata]] for her [[Parent/Legends|father]], the Mandalorian mercenary [[Kal Skirata]]. Approving of their falsified request to free the prisoner, the 55th's lieutenant sent the four men to the [[Hut Eight Bravo]] detention wing, where Ruusaan was being kept.<ref name="Order 66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 55th Mechanized Brigade appeared in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="Order 66" />
